title: SKOS Vocabulary
description: An RDF vocabulary for describing the basic structure and content of concept schemes such as thesauri, classification schemes, subject heading lists, taxonomies, 'folksonomies', other types of controlled vocabulary, and also concept schemes embedded in glossaries and terminologies.

terms.label: Collection
terms.definition: A meaningful collection of concepts.

terms.label: Concept
terms.definition: An idea or notion; a unit of thought.

terms.label: Concept Scheme
terms.definition: A set of concepts, optionally including statements about semantic relationships between those concepts.
examples: Thesauri, classification schemes, subject heading lists, taxonomies, 'folksonomies', and other types of controlled vocabulary are all examples of concept schemes. Concept schemes are also embedded in glossaries and terminologies.

terms.label: Ordered Collection
terms.definition: An ordered collection of concepts, where both the grouping and the ordering are meaningful.

terms.label: has broader
terms.definition: Relates a concept to a concept that is more general in meaning.
comments: Broader concepts are typically rendered as parents in a concept hierarchy (tree).

terms.label: has broader match
terms.definition: skos:broadMatch is used to state a hierarchical mapping link between two conceptual resources in different concept schemes.

terms.label: has broader transitive
terms.definition: skos:broaderTransitive is a transitive superproperty of skos:broader.

terms.label: has close match
terms.definition: skos:closeMatch is used to link two concepts that are sufficiently similar that they can be used interchangeably in some information retrieval applications. In order to avoid the possibility of "compound errors" when combining mappings across more than two concept schemes, skos:closeMatch is not declared to be a transitive property.

terms.label: has exact match
terms.definition: skos:exactMatch is used to link two concepts, indicating a high degree of confidence that the concepts can be used interchangeably across a wide range of information retrieval applications. skos:exactMatch is a transitive property, and is a sub-property of skos:closeMatch.
comments: skos:exactMatch is disjoint with each of the properties skos:broadMatch and skos:relatedMatch.

terms.label: has member
terms.definition: Relates a collection to one of its members.

terms.label: has member list
terms.definition: Relates an ordered collection to the RDF list containing its members.
comments:
For any resource, every item in the list given as the value of the
      skos:memberList property is also a value of the skos:member property.

terms.label: has narrower
terms.definition: Relates a concept to a concept that is more specific in meaning.
comments: Narrower concepts are typically rendered as children in a concept hierarchy (tree).

terms.label: has narrower match
terms.definition: skos:narrowMatch is used to state a hierarchical mapping link between two conceptual resources in different concept schemes.

terms.label: has narrower transitive
terms.definition: skos:narrowerTransitive is a transitive superproperty of skos:narrower.

terms.label: has related
terms.definition: Relates a concept to a concept with which there is an associative semantic relationship.

terms.label: has related match
terms.definition: skos:relatedMatch is used to state an associative mapping link between two conceptual resources in different concept schemes.

terms.label: has top concept
terms.definition: Relates, by convention, a concept scheme to a concept which is topmost in the broader/narrower concept hierarchies for that scheme, providing an entry point to these hierarchies.

terms.label: is in mapping relation with
terms.definition: Relates two concepts coming, by convention, from different schemes, and that have comparable meanings
comments: These concept mapping relations mirror semantic relations, and the data model defined below is similar (with the exception of skos:exactMatch) to the data model defined for semantic relations. A distinct vocabulary is provided for concept mapping relations, to provide a convenient way to differentiate links within a concept scheme from links between concept schemes. However, this pattern of usage is not a formal requirement of the SKOS data model, and relies on informal definitions of best practice.

terms.label: is in scheme
terms.definition: Relates a resource (for example a concept) to a concept scheme in which it is included.

terms.label: is in semantic relation with
terms.definition: Links a concept to a concept related by meaning.

terms.label: is top concept in scheme
terms.definition: Relates a concept to the concept scheme that it is a top level concept of.

terms.label: notation
terms.definition: A notation, also known as classification code, is a string of characters such as "T58.5" or "303.4833" used to uniquely identify a concept within the scope of a given concept scheme.

terms.label: alternative label
terms.definition: An alternative lexical label for a resource.
comments: The range of skos:altLabel is the class of RDF plain literals.
skos:prefLabel, skos:altLabel and skos:hiddenLabel are pairwise disjoint properties.
examples: Acronyms, abbreviations, spelling variants, and irregular plural/singular forms may be included among the alternative labels for a concept. Mis-spelled terms are normally included as hidden labels (see skos:hiddenLabel).

terms.label: change note
terms.definition: A note about a modification to a concept.

terms.label: definition
terms.definition: A statement or formal explanation of the meaning of a concept.

terms.label: editorial note
terms.definition: A note for an editor, translator or maintainer of the vocabulary.

terms.label: example
terms.definition: An example of the use of a concept.

terms.label: hidden label
terms.definition: A lexical label for a resource that should be hidden when generating visual displays of the resource, but should still be accessible to free text search operations.
comments: The range of skos:hiddenLabel is the class of RDF plain literals.
skos:prefLabel, skos:altLabel and skos:hiddenLabel are pairwise disjoint properties.

terms.label: history note
terms.definition: A note about the past state/use/meaning of a concept.

terms.label: note
terms.definition: A general note, for any purpose.

terms.label: preferred label
terms.definition: The preferred lexical label for a resource, in a given language.
comments: The range of skos:prefLabel is the class of RDF plain literals.
A resource has no more than one value of skos:prefLabel per language tag, and no more than one value of skos:prefLabel without language tag.

skos:prefLabel, skos:altLabel and skos:hiddenLabel are pairwise
      disjoint properties.

terms.label: scope note
terms.definition: A note that helps to clarify the meaning and/or the use of a concept.
